transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and the controls for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Are there any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements I should know about? Both the East and West rooms can be made ready tomorrow morning, so let's get any issues on the table now.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern before any assignment is approved. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified the room ratings this morning: East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the cabinet cannot safely go in East Room — it would exceed the floor-load rating by 300 kilograms. West Room can handle it. This floor-load note hasn't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but it directly affects which room should be assigned to the equipment-issue desk.

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I have a critical infrastructure requirement to flag. The protected medical-records desk can connect to the required isolated network only through the fiber patch panel in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow. I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the medical-records desk needs to go in East Room — the West Room doesn't have the fiber patch panel for that isolated network connection.
